class.name: NetwPropertySet
class.brief_description: The properties of a script that are synchronized together, in the order they are sent.
class.description: A set is built from the [method Netw.configure_property] calls of a script. The type and quantizer of each property come from its [NetwSchema]. The set decides which properties are sent, in what order, and how. Properties are sent in the order of [method keys], with no names on the wire. Both peers must build the same set, which [method wire_hash] checks.

method.name: bind
method.description: Adds [param column] to the end of the set and returns it.

method.name: column_type_for
method.description: Returns the column type of [param property] on [param script]. Built-in properties such as [code]position[/code] are read from [param node], and are [constant NetwMultiplayer.COLUMN_VARIANT] without one.

method.name: compile_against
method.description: Reads the type of every property from [param node], then calls [method seal]. Does nothing on a sealed set.

method.name: keys
method.description: Returns the property names, in the order they are sent.

method.name: member
method.description: Returns the column at [param schema_column] in the schema, or [code]null[/code] when this set does not include it.

method.name: quantizers
method.description: Returns the quantizer of each property, in the same order as [method keys], or [code]null[/code] for a property sent as is.

method.name: reproject_lanes
method.description: Call it after changing [member NetwPropertySetColumn.lane] on a column, so the next send uses the new lane.

method.name: seal
method.description: Locks the set and computes [method wire_hash]. It does not read property types, so an untyped set seals with every column as [constant NetwMultiplayer.COLUMN_VARIANT] and sends nothing. Use [method compile_against].

method.name: stamp_column_types
method.description: Reads the type of every property in [param set] from [param node], or from [param script] when [param node] does not have it.

method.name: wire_hash
method.description: Returns a 32-bit hash of the properties, their order, types, quantizers and lanes. Peers with different hashes cannot read each other's packets.
